_comment: Pinned losing seed: 1. A PASS means the fight was lost, defeat confirmed, and the auto slot reloaded.

steps._comment: Meet Relc (12,13) before the ally_requires-gated chieftains_raid fight.
SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.

Issue #76 ducking proof: dialogue_started sidechains the Music bus by WIAudio.MUSIC_DUCK_DB (-6dB) relative to the untouched default slider (0dB, no settings.cfg in this isolated QA run) -- wait_frames lets the MUSIC_DUCK_FADE_SEC (0.2s) tween settle before the raw-dB read (assert_audio_bus_volume_db, distinct from assert_audio_bus_volume's slider-formula variant).

Issue #76 ducking proof (release half): dialogue_ended restores the Music bus to the SAME pre-duck base (re-derived from get_bus_volume, never from whatever the bus happened to read -- see _tween_music_bus_to's doc comment), not just 'louder than ducked'.

Classless start -> hotbar 3 slots (was 4). This script's SUBJECT is the defeat->auto-reload flow (victory:false -> game_loaded, no game_reset), orthogonal to the PC kit -- the classless PC still LOSES chieftains_raid at seed 1 (easier to lose classless; baseline-verified only this pin failed), so a pin edit suffices, no warrior prologue.

Issue #76: the defeat stinger (data/audio.json's music_defeat, xDeviruchi 'Never Give Up', combat_finished/{victory:false}) and the PC death bark (pc_death, combatant_downed/{id:pc}) -- this pinned losing seed guarantees both actually fire, not just that combat_finished carries victory:false.
